senses.gloss: fulness, full growth. Pesik. Haḥod., p. 53ᵃ (ref. to Ps. LXXXIX, 38, v. preced.) אם זכיתם … למְלֵיאָתָהּ if you will do good, you shall count (your historical records) by the nation’s growth to fulness, opp. פגם decrease; Pesik. R. s. 15, a. e., v. preced.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>נבראו … על מְלֵיאָתָן</he> those things had been created in perfect condition.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:5">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>על מְלֵיאָתָהּ על מְלֵיאָתוֹ</he> fully developed.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:7">Num. R. s. 12</cite>; a. e.—

senses.gloss: (the priestly gifts from) the ripe or stored fruits.
units: Tem. 4ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XXII, 28) מ׳ זו ביכורים m’leah means the first fruits; Mekh. Mishp. s. 19 אלו ביכורים הנטלין מהמ׳ that means the first fruits which are taken from the fulness (the stored fruits). Ib. בכורים שהם קרויין … ומ׳ first fruits which go by four names, reshith … and m’leah; Yalk. Ex. 351.
